title.narrative: SWE-2012-051: A Farewell to Arms? Defections, recidivism and successful reintegration of ex-combatants in Colombias civil war.
SWE-2012-051: A Farewell to Arms? Defections, recidivism and successful reintegration of ex-combatants in Colombias civil war.

description.narrative: The main aim of this project is to examine combatants choices at the end of the rebel life-cycle, seeking answers to three distinct research questions: 1 Who defects from armed groups (main hypothesis: fear-induced defections are important)? 2 What determines recidivism into organized crime (main hypotheses: groups succeed paramilitary groups; emerge mainly in regions having lootable resources)? 3 What determines successful reintegration from disarmament, demobilization and reintegration (DDR) programs (hypothesis: individual characteristics and structural factors matter - no priors on strength of effects)? Our hypotheses stem from previous findings in the research group based on qualitative analysis and limited samples. Our quantitative analyses are complemented with smaller sample in-depth interviews to improve validity and illustrate causal mechanisms.
